profile_text.body:
Seagate Technology Holdings plc is a public company, traded under the ticker STX, with headquarters listed in Singapore. Its SEC filings are recorded under CIK 0001137789. On its own site, Seagate describes itself as a leader in mass-capacity data storage and says it has delivered more than four billion terabytes of capacity over the past four decades. The company says it makes storage that scales and aims to bring trust and integrity to innovations that depend on data.

The site frames AI as a driver of data growth that is reshaping storage requirements. Seagate says people and machines will create in more ways and at a faster pace as AI proliferates, producing large volumes of data, and it invites organizations to evaluate their readiness and develop a storage strategy built for performance, scale, and growth. The company states that it is optimizing storage for AI and making gains in capacity to support efficient data center architecture and buildout.

Beyond the corporate profile, the record holds no tracked products, no lawsuits, and no MCP servers for Seagate.
